# Independent contract/source verification

Verdict recommendation: CONDITIONAL. Full review of final corrected target-pin.json. Zero MATERIAL-CORE and zero MATERIAL-REMEDY findings. The scoped exit test is met: the proposed alternatives have no identified unresolved material contradiction, the four storage/identity/dispatch/termination questions are answered at design scope, and remaining deployment decisions and integration claims are explicitly gated. This is not production qualification or PASS; BD-1 through BD-6 and A-60 through A-74 remain open at their stated scopes.

Final recheck: P2-S now explicitly requires stopped workspace bytes remain readable through sealing, or qualified post-quiescence publication before destructive removal without a mutation interval. Existing HostSession teardown does not promise extraction. This is a valid acceptance clarification of A-61/A-63, not proof of a new storage primitive. Destroying the sole bytes fails preservation; final plan SHA-256 is 1373e5dec887c0132a1c832e694d6b69fd4978955434ae2b1522f32966d11b0c. All four current target hashes were reverified after this addition, and all earlier pins remain recorded in the source inventory. Verdict/counts unchanged.

## Isolation and evidence

Fresh role storage_contract_review read the complete candidate specification, plan and both sidecars only after the root froze the candidate. No root synthesis, prior reviewer reports or other reviewer conclusions were read. Research captures were treated as source inventories, not votes. Independently verified original four target hashes, then final corrected four hashes, repository HEAD and all 14 dirty-file hashes. EV-35 now accurately identifies a read of the captured five-query results; both prose tables and both sidecars match. Primary Docs grounding was independently retrieved rather than inherited.

Temporal Docs runtime discovery succeeded; 10 successful connector calls, zero failed connector calls. Primary returned chunks are captured in contract-source-identities.json. Live documentation is mutable corroboration captured for this review, not installed runtime proof. Atlas query/read wrappers were used for sdk-python, features and canary-go. The critic SKILL.md and complete rubric/checklist/decision-guide were shell-read and applied; its own declared name is temporal-workflow-design-critic. Optional developer skill temporal:temporal-developer, Python guide, determinism and versioning references were consulted. No native Skill tool load is claimed. No runtime/model/installation/storage fault experiment ran. Root owns final manifest and gate.

Reference: design-base HEAD c79bdb516f4a4fe343bb97c1c97b39f0d796c450 plus the 14 matching dirty hashes. Greenfield application; current integration is mandatory dependency evidence. Existing files remain unchanged. Captured full hashes and exact source locations are in contract-source-identities.json.

## Primary evidence key

R1: integration src/temporalio/claude_agent_sdk/_runner.py:532-592, 397-457, 676-705, 1239-1266. Original pending recovery requires bound policy, SDK fields and conditional append; attempts above one/fork refuse. Head guard advances only after successful conditional append. Caller owns workspace/outcome/host validation.

R2: _workflow.py:537-553, 568-656, 699-713, 447-490. Policy execution is unavailable and fails closed; accepted segment result precedes deferred tool dispatch. Current generic retry/fork behavior is not the proposed original-pending route.

R3: _session_store.py:27-37, 51-60, 81-140. FileSessionStore is local/single-machine example and has append/load only; process-local lock and UUID suppression do not establish distributed CAS, conflicting UUID rejection, rollback protection or protected authority. A new qualified adapter is required.

R4: _session_control.py:26-38, 195-237; experiments/host_session.py:235-250, 375-438; host_ownership.py:396. Cooperative SDK receipts differ from actual local Docker-daemon containment; unresolved launch/termination refuses admission. Same-host proof is not remote host-failure proof.

R5: experiments/write_recovery.py:175-241, 584-636; tests/test_pending_recovery.py:145-163. Existing protected fixed-command invocation and SQLite conditional append are bounded precedents; exact original session/first attempt refusal is real.

D1: https://docs.temporal.io/encyclopedia/event-history/event-history-python#How-History-Replay-Provides-Durable-Execution and https://docs.temporal.io/workflow-execution/workflowid-runid#run-id
D2: https://docs.temporal.io/workflow-execution/workflowid-runid#workflow-id-reuse-policy
D3: https://docs.temporal.io/handling-messages#message-handler-patterns and https://docs.temporal.io/design-patterns/entity-workflow#implementation

A1: atlas://code/features/features/update/deduplication/feature.py demonstrates same Update ID deduplication before handler completion.
A2: atlas://code/sdk-python/temporalio/workflow/_handlers.py provides Update primitives, not distributed effect authority.
A3: atlas://code/canary-go/versioning.go demonstrates deployment/version routing validation, not engine resume compatibility or the proposed handover.

M1: independently reopened https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-code/52c76441cae91f6891e4712306bffb057ff6fec5/mods/types/claude-code.d.ts with matching SHA-256 8ae1244d19d4b393261605fe72d517b66be0d7e1c214c378cdec5107e8b0b46c. Lines 3235-3251, 4217-4253, 9502-9508, 9790-9797, 10419-10425 and 10480-10486 were directly reread. Fail-open dispatch, bounded own-time, fresh ordinary next requests, reserved identity and stream/result split corroborate the candidate's optional-lane constraints.

## Precedent classification

Sanctioned primitives: history replay, per-run Update deduplication, Entity Workflow state ownership, handler-drained CAN with carried state, receiver-enforced idempotency and External Storage claim check. Sources D1-D5/D7 and A1/A2 support those exact smaller mechanisms.

Partial composed precedent: accepted head plus immutable exact SDK trajectory adapter; independently retained Entity Update intent plus one protected existing effect Activity; stable logical identity across outer Reset; cold workspace plus trajectory sealed receipt; orphan typed completion adoption; terminated-owner recovery on compatible pinned engine. Sources above support pieces but no inspected official pattern demonstrates this whole composition. Each stays conditional on its named falsifiable tests.

none_found complete mechanism: distributed original Claude pending recovery with immutable matched workspace, independent rollback-resistant dispatch authority and verified physical termination; optional accepted complete inference escrow. This is a bounded search result, not a claim no implementation exists. Absence of exact precedent is not itself a required correction; the candidate already names it and withholds guarantees.

## Findings and correction gate

C-O1 OWNER-DECISION: BD-1/BD-2/BD-3 determine supported host/service/storage failures, authority rollback contract, terminal authority and retention/reset horizon. Scope anchors INV-1/5/A-60..64/A-68. Mandatory basis is the explicitly offered failure contract and independently read R1/R4/D2/D5/D7. Without those choices, host-loss preservation/exclusivity cannot be advertised. Required response is the existing M0 decision record and M2/M4 qualification, not a reviewer-selected storage product.

C-O2 OWNER-DECISION: BD-4/BD-5/BD-6 determine bounded deadlines/load, optional confidentiality and adoption/optional native/escrow scope. Scope anchors INV-2/4/6/7 and plan M0. Missing numbers/platform are explicitly open, not unsafe hidden defaults. Existing milestone criteria are appropriate.

C-A1 ACCEPTANCE-CRITERION: A-60/A-61/A-63 exact recovery composition must pass P2/P2-S/P4/P6-S with conflicting UUID, typed false/0, stale head, ACK loss, destroyed local disk, metadata and live writer negative cases. Existing plan already contains these. Failure consequence is wrong conversation or workspace under accepted receipt. No further mechanism is prescribed.

C-A2 ACCEPTANCE-CRITERION: A-62/A-64/A-68 dispatch composition must pass P1-T/P2-I/P3/P5/P8-S/P9-S, including repeated successful Update reply, changed Update IDs with same logical key, authority admin reset/recreate, retained CAN tombstones, and external physical witness. Existing plan covers these; model-free fake authorities do not close real service/containment semantics.

C-A3 ACCEPTANCE-CRITERION: A-67/A-71..74 must use actual exact installed SDK/runtime provenance and required-hook/provider boundaries. Current pinned declaration and historical 0.2.154 loading failure cannot prove later runtime activation. Candidate correctly separates tests and keeps selected proof 0.2.162/2.1.274 from lock 0.2.154.

C-N1 NONMATERIAL: the plan's assumption table names optional confidential P10 while M5 describes the cases without a P10 subheading. This is a minor internal label mismatch; M5's acceptance is directly readable and the lane is BD-5 gated. It does not change validity or exit test.

Counts: MATERIAL-CORE 0; MATERIAL-REMEDY 0; OWNER-DECISION 2; ACCEPTANCE-CRITERION 3; NONMATERIAL 1; INCORRECT 0. Proposed remedy mechanisms remain proposals; none was promoted to verified distributed behavior in this review.

## Transitive repository impact

Primary change classification: feature with operational_change, security_change, schema/migration and test_change implications. Confirmed integration surfaces: runner SessionStore guard/callback/options; Workflow accepted output/policy dispatch/AgentState/handover; segment Activity heartbeat/retry; session control stop/refusal; protected native effect wrapper and outcome identity; supervisor launch/admission/teardown; package/policy capability checks; converter/external storage and lock provenance; gateway Update validation; retention/cleanup.

Likely new application surfaces: exact blob materializer and accepted-head receipt, workspace manifest/restore/reattach, independent entity or unique-store adapter, service/admin permission guard, object lifecycle and rollout wiring. These do not exist as deployed application modules. The plan must implement through existing seams; no separate model executor is justified.

Current FileSessionStore UUID suppression and one-host SQLite proof are narrowed correctly. Current _workflow generic retry/fork semantics remain compatible only because original-pending specialization explicitly uses one attempt and refuses fork. Entity authority must own the scheduling decision rather than returning a repeatable successful permission. Old client/worker/package/codec/reset consumers and janitor paths are transitive authority bypass surfaces, covered by M1/M4 qualification.

## Phasing and release posture

Phasing is required because state/schema/authority, physical substrate, model runtime, permissions and retention cross independently failing components. M0 settles owner/proof envelope; M1 proves deterministic protocol and mutations while unavailable executor remains closed; M2 qualifies real two-host storage/physical termination; M3 qualifies exact original native recovery; M4 closes security/retention/version/load and final canonical spending gate; M5 is optional confidentiality. Dependencies are coherent. Each failed stage stops activation; no uncertain claim is deleted or silently rolled back. Canonical v1 remains authority until BD-6 adopted extension, and release remains blocked on failed tests/open decisions. Later concrete deployment pins must turn P9 rollout/drain/migration into exact commands; the current proposal does not claim an already-safe deployed migration.

## Limits

This report verifies design claims and falsifiable qualification coverage, not execution success. No repository-wide exhaustive file read is claimed. Atlas supplied SDK/conformance/building-block precedent, not full sample coverage. Provider host-loss controls, actual bundle fidelity, selected store guarantees, installed Mod APIs and physical authority are future qualification. Root should retain CONDITIONAL until owners and tests close these gates.
